# pve_notification_endpoint_goty (Data Source)

Reads a single Gotify notification endpoint from `GET /cluster/notifications/endpoints/gotify/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_notification_endpoint_goty" "mobile_push" {
  name = "gotify"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the endpoint to look up.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether this target is disabled.
- `server` (String) Server URL of the Gotify instance.
